# Pls send halp

Big tech and an abusive misunderstanding of free and open source software practices have led us to believe that software production, server maintenance and on-line services should be free as in gratis. However there is no such things as a free lunch and software does not exist in a vacuum.

If we want sustainable alternatives and a diverse cultural sector, these alternatives and the humans behind them, need to be supported. If LURK is useful to you, and if you can afford it, please help us by donating. [...] LURK logo

Welcome to LURK, we host, facilitate and archive discussions around net- and computational culture and politics, proto- and post-free culture practices, (experimental) (sound) (new media) (software) art, and things like that…

We’re volunteer run and wish to:

 give the opportunity for individuals, groups and collectives working on net- and computational culture to have a presence outside of corporate silos, surveillance capitalism and closed facebook groups;
 offer a place where discussions and resources on self-hosting and alternative network infrastructures can exist outside of libertarian and pepe discourses;
 provide ourselves with something high-quality to procrastinate with, share good memes and eat pop-corn;
 etc.

𓅣

# Services [...] 𓊬

# LURK infra

We currently use three machines:

 agnesbaxter is a VPS provided by our friends at servus.at
 vrijdagmiddagborrel is a VPS provided by eclips.is/Greenhost
 skattkista is our backup machine which is a re-purposed net-top running in a university somewhere

𓉔

# We

LURK is used by several communities coming from a variety of cultural, ethnic and professional backgrounds. We strive for LURK to be welcoming to people of these various backgrounds and provide a non-toxic and harassment-free environment. Our (work-in-progress) Code of Conduct, Terms of Services and Privacy Statement can be found here

results.title: Get Support - Lurk Docs
results.content:
## ​ Product issues

Contact support if:

 a page is broken
 something will not load
 a search result looks wrong
 saved data is missing
 you cannot access your account
 a feature behaves differently than expected
 something looks broken on mobile
 you think Lurk is showing stale or incorrect information

## ​ Billing or account issues

For billing, subscription, account, or access issues, include the email tied to your Lurk account. Do not send passwords, private keys, API keys, or sensitive financial information over email.

## ​ Security issues

If you believe you found a security issue, include SECURITY in the subject line. Example:

```
SECURITY: Possible exposed data issueSECURITY: Possible exposed data issue 
```

Security reports should include: [...] Security reports should include:

 what you found
 where you found it
 steps to reproduce if possible
 screenshots only if they do not expose sensitive third-party information\

## ​ Feedback and feature requests

Feature requests are welcome, but Lurk is intentionally focused during beta. The best feedback explains:

 what you were trying to do
 where the current product slowed you down
 what workaround you used
 how often the problem happens
 why it matters to your workflow

## ​ Response expectations

Lurk is an early product. Support is handled directly and prioritized by severity. Highest priority:

1. security issues
2. account/access problems
3. broken core workflows
4. incorrect or stale product behavior
5. general questions and feature requests

# Get Support

Lurk is early, but support should still be simple. If something is broken, confusing, missing, or not working the way you expected, use this page to figure out where to go.

## Fastest way to get help

For most issues, contact support at: support@lurk-ai.com Include:

 what you were trying to do
 what happened
 what you expected to happen
 your browser/device
 screenshots or screen recordings if useful
 any error message you saw

The more specific you are, the faster the issue can be understood.
